messages:
cust-acme: Hey team — we're seeing records for our project still return in search after we called the DELETE API and waited the TTL. Customer expects purge by 2025-07-01, but objects are visible. Request IDs: req_0a1b2c3d, req_0a1b2c3e. Any idea? :confused:

jana-support: Sorry about that, can you paste one object id and the API response you got? also your org id and whether you used custom retention?

cust-acme: Obj IDs: obj_98321, obj_98322. Org: acme-inc-42. We have custom retention shorter than default (30d) via policy id pol_42. DELETE call returned 202 for both. Sample: ```curl -X DELETE https://api.redwood.ai/v1/objects/obj_98321 -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-XXX' -v``` response headers included `X-Request-ID: req_0a1b2c3d` and body `{ "status":"queued" }`.

jana-support: 202 queued is expected. Can you try HEAD or search and paste the search response? are they visible in search index or just accessible via direct object GET?

cust-acme: Visible via search (results show snippet). Direct GET returns 404 for obj_98321 but search returns a hit with tombstone=false. Weird.

eli-sre: Looking at deletion pipeline for acme-inc-42. I see deletion jobs processed but indexer lag for region us-west-2: "index_delay_ms": 452000. There's an ongoing indexer rehydrate after a failed rollout. Also seeing KMS key state: "kms_key_status":"pending_rotation" for key key-acme-2025. That can block final tombstone eviction if vault decrypt fails during export verification.

security-team: Confirming: no legal hold flagged on acme-inc-42. We do see an earlier manual retention override applied on 2025-05-10 (policy pol_42) that shortened TTL. retention-bot shows: "policy_applied: custom_30d on 2025-05-10 by user jamal@acme".

retention-bot: Automated note: deletion-worker-7 processed 2 objects, state: tombstoned->awaiting-index-eviction. Indexer health: degraded. KMS: rotation pending, decrypt attempts failing 1/5.

jana-support: Thanks. Root cause hypothesis: indexer lag + KMS rotation causing export verification to stall, leaving search index entries present while object storage shows 404. Action plan: 1) request accelerated reindex for affected ids; 2) ask keys team to prioritize rotation or rollback; 3) provide timeline to customer.

cust-acme: Timeline would be great — legal asked for confirmation this week.

eli-sre: Quick repro to validate pipeline: 1) call DELETE (returns 202). 2) inspect deletion-status API: ```GET /v1/deletions/req_0a1b2c3d``` returns { "state":"awaiting-index-eviction","retry_count":3 } 3) check indexer tail: ```/infra/indexer/tail?org=acme-inc-42``` shows last processed sequence 12098 vs head 12150.

eli-sre: I've kicked an emergency reindex for sequence 12100-12150 for acme-inc-42. Also flagged key-acme-2025 for immediate rollback to last-good version to allow decrypts.

security-team: Rolling key back requires PM approval for audit reasons — I approved for emergency. Documenting: incident-2025-07-retention-ACME.

jana-support: I'll send a note to the customer: short ETA ~3-6 hours pending reindex and key rollback. Will follow up with logs once done.

cust-acme: Thanks. Can you also confirm whether billing/usage is affected? We saw some generated embedding costs spike during retries yesterday.

eli-sre: Deletion retries caused additional transient read attempts but not significant token billing. I'll pull token-level cost breakdown and post if anything >$50.

retention-bot: Update: reindex job completed for sequences 12100-12150 (duration 14m). Deletion-status for req_0a1b2c3d now `evicted_from_index`. KMS rollback completed, decrypt success rate 5/5.

eli-sre: Verified search no longer returns obj_98321 for acme-inc-42. Direct GET remains 404, search zero hits.

jana-support: Update sent to customer: "We identified indexer lag + KMS rotation as the blocker. We performed an emergency reindex and rolled the key back; objects were evicted from index at 2025-07-02T15:24:11Z. No data was restored. Apologies for the disruption, we'll follow up with a post-incident summary." :white_check_mark:

cust-acme: Confirmed — search clean now. Please share the incident summary and any recommendations to avoid (we use custom 30d policy).

security-team: Recommendations: - monitor indexer lag alerts (threshold 300s) - schedule KMS rotations during low-deletion windows - add deletion pipeline pre-check that blocks rotations when deletions in flight > 100 - add audit log webhook to notify customers when tombstone eviction delayed > 1h.

jana-support: I'll open a follow-up ticket to product/reliability for the pre-check and webhook. Ticket: PROD-4892.

cust-acme: Thanks all, appreciate the quick help :pray:
